turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?
Standard shipping at Nerds Store usually takes **2 to 4 business days**.
Got it, thanks! What about express shipping? Is it much faster, and does it cost extra?

Express shipping usually takes **1 to 2 business days**, so it's faster than standard shipping.

The knowledge base doesn't include express shipping fees, so I can't confirm whether it costs extra. For pricing details, you can contact support at **support@nerdsstore.example**.
Thanks, that helps! Do you know if there's a cutoff time for orders to ship the same day?

I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't include a same-day shipping cutoff time, so I can't confirm that. You can reach the support team at **support@nerdsstore.example** for details. Our business hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, if you'd like to contact them by phone or during those hours.
Got it, thanks! Last thing: do you know if international orders ship on the same timeline, or do they take longer?

Nerds Store doesn't offer international shipping, so there's no international timeline to compare. Orders are shipped domestically only, with standard taking 2 to 4 business days and express taking 1 to 2 business days.
Okay, that clears it up. One last thing: is there a way to track my order once it ships?
Yes. Tracking information becomes available once a carrier has been assigned to your order. If you share your order number, I can check its current status and tracking details for you.
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks so much for the help!
You're welcome! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask. Have a great day!
